HOW A LANCE IS DECIDED: compare BEST CARDS first; if those tie, the SECOND card decides, then the third, then the fourth. Holding the single best card does NOT win the lance on its own -- four ases beat as+dos+tres+sota at Chica, and three players can each hold an as. Grande wants HIGH cards (rey=tres highest), Chica wants LOW ones (as lowest). A team's value is the BETTER of its two hands, never the two combined.

Rules of this phase:
- "mus": want to replace cards (only happens if EVERYONE says mus). "no": denies mus -> NOBODY discards, the hand is played as dealt. The mano (first seat) may "ordago".

SENAS (reglamentarias): fixed gestures with fixed meanings, addressed to YOUR PARTNER only, made at the table during ANYONE's deliberation -- including your partner's (that is the point of a sena). Opponents do not see them.
"muerde-el-labio-inferior" = dos reyes (para Grande)  [fournier]
"muerde-el-labio-hacia-un-lado" = tres reyes  [fournier]
"saca-la-punta-de-la-lengua" = dos ases (para Chica)  [fournier]
"saca-la-lengua-hacia-un-lado" = tres ases  [fournier]
"torcer-los-labios" = medias (tres iguales)  [fournier]
"elevar-las-cejas" = duples (dos parejas o cuatro iguales)  [fournier]
"guinar-el-ojo" = tengo 31 -- o, a Juego no, el mejor punto (30)  [fournier]
"cerrar-los-ojos" = ciego: ni pares ni juego  [donnaipe]
"lanzar-un-beso" = la bonita: tres reyes y un as  [donnaipe]
Most hands have NO seña available: then gesture nothing. A gesture is only worth making if it can still reach your partner in time to change a decision.

SIGNAL POLICY: declare WHEN you gesture with "signal_policy" -- declarative rules the table interprets (no code). Each rule fires ONLY if its gesture is true of your hand at that moment. Null/omitted keeps your current policy. Schema:

{"rules": [{"gesture": "<one sena>", "when_phase": "MUS_REQUEST|MUS_DRAW|DECLARE|ENVITE|ORDAGO_RESPONSE|*", "when_lance": "Grande|Chica|Pares|Juego|*", "when_deciding": "partner|any", "offset": <0..0.95>, "ttl": <0..20>, "bluff": false}], "enabled": true}

offset = where inside the deciding seat's deliberation window you make the gesture; ttl = lifetime in decision-window units (a full table rotation is ~4, so a gesture meant for your partner's NEXT decision needs ttl > ~4). Rules fire only while TRUE of your hand, unless "bluff": true and this table allows sena bluffs. A gesture your partner already caught is not repeated.
